questions.label: Save corruption after cryo sleep
questions.question: Why does my save get corrupted after cryo sleep on PS5, and is it fixed?

response.answer: The corruption happens because on version 1.0.0 the cryo‑pod autosave isn’t atomic. If the PS5 is put into Rest Mode or Quick‑Resume while the save is writing (the ~1.5‑3 s fade), only the header is written and the world data is truncated, and the backup rotation also overwrites the previous slot, causing a checksum failure (see BUG‑0010, BUG‑0001, BUG‑0015). This was fixed in version 1.0.1, where autosaves are written atomically and the previous save is kept as a backup, so suspending the console no longer corrupts the save (PATCH‑1.0.1, DOC‑troubleshooting‑guide, DOC‑player‑faq).

sources.title: Save fails checksum after cryo-sleep autosave is interrupted by console suspend
sources.snippet: Cryo pod sleep triggers a full autosave (CryoSerializer). If the console enters rest mode while the write is in flight (~1.5-3 s window during the fade), the save header is written with the new checksum but the world chunk block is truncated. On resume the load fails checksum validation. The rotating backup is also overwritten in the same pass because backup rotation happens before the write instead of after it, so there is no recoverable slot. Repro 6/10 on PS5 devkit, not reproducible on PC...

sources.title: Troubleshooting Guide - Save file corrupted or will not load
sources.snippet:
Symptoms: the save slot shows *Corrupted*, the game reports a checksum error, or the load gets stuck at 0%.

1. Check your version. Saves corrupted by an interrupted cryo-sleep autosave on 1.0.0 (most often on PS5 rest mode or Xbox Quick Resume) were the cause of most reports; 1.0.1 made those writes atomic.
2. Open **Load Game**, highlight the slot and choose **Restore Backup**.
3. On PS5 and Xbox, make sure the console's cloud storage has finished syncing before you start the game.

sources.title: Patch 1.0.1: fix for BUG-0001
sources.snippet: Cryo-sleep autosaves are now written atomically; suspending the console mid-save no longer corrupts the save or its backup.

sources.title: Player FAQ - How does saving work?
sources.snippet:
The game autosaves when you sleep in the cryo pod, when you leave a moon and every 15 minutes. A spinning saving icon appears in the bottom-right corner while a save is being written. Since version 1.0.1 cryo-sleep autosaves are written atomically and the previous save is kept as a backup, so an interrupted save can no longer corrupt both copies.

questions.label: Hover-rover crashes
questions.question: What crashes happen when driving the hover-rover?

response.answer: Driving the hover‑rover can trigger a crash where the game asserts that the vertical velocity is not NaN. The crash log (CRASH-0006) shows an assertion failure in HoverComponent.cpp:166 caused by a NaN Z‑velocity after the hover raycasts miss on a steep canyon slope, leading to a division‑by‑zero on the hit distance. This occurs when the rover falls through terrain on steep slopes in Ridge Canyon.

questions.label: Cross-save between PC and Switch
questions.question: Is cross-save between PC and Switch supported?

response.answer: Yes. Cross‑save is supported across platforms—including PC and Switch—by linking each platform’s account to the same Starfall ID. The feature, added in version 1.2.0, lets you continue the same worlds on any platform via cloud storage.

sources.title: Platform and System Requirements - Storage and save data
sources.snippet: Install size is about 35 GB on PC and consoles and 14 GB on Switch. Each save slot takes 20–60 MB depending on the size of your outpost. Cloud saves are handled by each platform's own cloud storage; cross-save between platforms is a separate feature that uses your Starfall ID (see the co-op and cross-save guide).

sources.title: Co-op and Cross-Save Guide - Cross-save
sources.snippet:
Cross-save, added in Deep Core (1.2.0), lets you continue the same worlds on any platform. Link each platform account to the same Starfall ID under **Settings → Account → Cross-Save**. Your saves upload to Starfall cloud storage when you quit to the main menu and download when you start the game.

voice_transcript.text: Hi, I'm StudioDesk, the voice assistant for Starfall Outpost. Ask me about a bug or crash, or tell me about a new one.
Why does my save get corrupted after cryo sleep on PS5, and is it fixed?

This corruption happens because the cryo pod autosave is not atomic on version one point zero point zero, so if the console is suspended during the save window, the file gets truncated. According to the patch notes for version one point zero point one, this was fixed by making the saves atomic and keeping a backup.
